Container.Name: reely
Container.Overview: Swipe together, watch together. A social movie-picking app for Plex. Each person swipes through your library independently -- when everyone loves the same film, it's a match.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the reely web interface.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: URL of your Plex Media Server, e.g. http://192.168.1.x:32400

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Your Plex authentication token. Find it in the Plex web app under Settings > Troubleshooting > Show.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where reely stores room state between restarts.

Config.Name: Basic Auth Username
Config.Description: Enable HTTP Basic Auth by setting both a username and password. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: Basic Auth Password
Config.Description: HTTP Basic Auth password. Required if Auth Username is set.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warning, error, critical.

Config.Name: Allowed Origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated extra WebSocket Origins to accept beyond same-origin. Only needed if a reverse proxy serves reely under an origin that differs from the container's Host header.
